input.summary: Shorten the Company's non-renewal notice window from 90 to 60 days while preserving HDI's 90-day notice.
input.comment: [Playbook] We shortened our non-renewal notice window from 90 to 60 days, which is our fallback maximum for automatic renewals, and left HDI's 90-day notice obligation unchanged.

ops.oldText: unless terminated by either Party hereto upon ninety (90) days written notice to the other
ops.newText: unless terminated by the Company upon sixty (60) days, or by HDI upon ninety (90) days, prior written notice to the other
